evidence.art: Title 000-003 and film 005-018 are cohesive, richly painted night-blue/amber work. Gate set 040-046 strong. Walk CG figures sit in a different rendering register than painted backdrops.
evidence.continuity: Ankhu barefoot in 014/015 and the closing painted still 048 but sandalled in 040-046. Film Anpu has bright collar/kilt trim vs dark CG Anpu. Sceptre head differs between 016 and 017. Sceptre length/verticality drift (low, tilted in 041/042/045).
evidence.cinematography: Film frames well composed. High-angle fixed cams read the causeway (021/025/030/037/040). 014/015 crop Anpu's head. Hard cuts read but 040-047 repeat one composition for 8 frames, then 048 jumps to an interior without a bridge.
evidence.motion_fx: Walk poses repetitive and stiff (031-033, 038-041). A visible pose pop at cut 025. Little foot dust or secondary motion. Figures merge into one dark blob by 042-046. The fade 046-047 is clean.
evidence.grounding: CG figures small vs the painted set. Shadows weak and detached, some feet float (038-041). Characters overlap and clip each other (031-033, 042-046). Figures stand in front of the gate without occlusion against the painted door.
evidence.game_feel: Road and cams guide the eye. Slow pacing, no handover of control. The last 6 frames (043-048) are a group standing at a doorway with no visible goal or input prompt.
evidence.ui_title: Logo and menu legible with clear hierarchy, but the menu type is small and the top emblem is flat grey. Subtitles readable (039-043) but linger across cuts (023-026) and fade muddily in 036.
evidence.audio: Judged from walk_anpu_lines.json and walk_ankhu_lines.json only, not actual audio. Strong writing, clean call-and-response cam2-cam6, a grave warm register. No timing/footstep/ambience data in the files, both marked DRAFT, cam6 has no Ankhu reply.

defects.what: CG mannequins are low-fidelity: floating feet, weak detached shadows, bodies overlapping/clipping each other and no occlusion against the painted gate. This is the most visible break from the painted set.

Ankhu's sandals appear and disappear (barefoot in 014/015/048). Film's bright-trimmed Anpu does not match the dark walk Anpu. Sceptre head and angle change between shots, tilted and short in 041/042/045.
Stiff repeating poses, a pose pop at cut 025, almost no foot dust. The last 8 walk frames (040-047) hold one static composition, so the sequence reads like a slideshow rather than a living walk.
